segments.description: UPDATED Segment layout for Digquad controller - Based on actual 711 LED installation with optimized allocation
changes_from_previous: Printer Interior Lid Light moved to DigQuad (was on MagWLED)
Front Door Left and Top merged into single segment (was 2 segments)
Reduced from per-tray AMS lighting to combined top/bottom per AMS
Combined tag bottoms and hygrometers into single neutral segment
Actual LED counts from physical installation (711 total)

strips.name: Printer Front Door (C-Shape)

segments.name: Front Door Bottom
segments.purpose: Print progress bar - displays percentage complete
segments.effects: Solid, dynamic fill based on progress %

segments.name: Front Door Left+Top (MERGED)
segments.purpose: Status indicator - MERGED left and top for consistent display

strips.name: AMS 1 Lid/Spool Lighting
strips.description: Reverse C-shape on AMS 1 lid for spool illumination - combined top and bottom

segments.name: AMS1 Tray Top (All Combined)
segments.purpose: Combined lighting for all 4 tray tops in AMS 1

segments.name: AMS1 Tray Bottom (Neutral)
segments.purpose: Neutral background lighting for tray bottoms

notes: Side wall LEDs (216-240) are distributed between top and bottom or can be grouped with one
Cannot individually control per-tray lighting due to segment limit
Use tag segments (7-10) to indicate which specific tray is active

strips.name: AMS 2 Lid/Spool Lighting

segments.name: AMS2 Tray Bottom (Neutral)
segments.purpose: Neutral background lighting for tray bottoms

notes: Side wall LEDs (358-381) are distributed between top and bottom
AMS 2 supports heating animation (amber) for drying mode
Use tag segments (11-14) to indicate which specific tray is active

segments.name: Tag Bottoms + Hygrometers (All Combined)
segments.purpose: Neutral background lighting for all tag bottoms and hygrometers
notes: This is a COMPLEX multi-range segment spanning GPIO 16 and 4
WLED may not support multi-GPIO segments - see implementation alternatives
Alternative: Create two separate segments (one for AMS1, one for AMS2)

strips.name: Printer Interior Lid Light
strips.description: Simple LED strip inside printer lid - MOVED from MagWLED to DigQuad
notes: This strip needs to be physically moved from MagWLED GPIO to DigQuad
Can be connected to any available DigQuad GPIO with 30 LED capacity
Simple single-segment control - perfect for final 16th segment
LED range TBD based on which GPIO pin is used and offset

implementation_notes: Segment 14 may need to be split into two segments if WLED doesn't support multi-GPIO segments
If split, use Segment 14 for AMS1 backgrounds and create new segment for AMS2 (would exceed 16 limit)
Alternative: Eliminate AMS tray bottoms entirely (segments 3, 5) to free up 2 slots
Final LED ranges depend on exact physical installation and GPIO connections
Test all segments incrementally during Phase 1 implementation
